title.zh: 将卡林加省 Pinukpuk 市镇 Apatan 描笼涯的 Pinukpuk 职业中学的 Tappo 附属校分离，改设为独立的同名职业中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Pinukpuk Vocational High School - Tappo Annex in Barangay Apatan, Municipality of Pinukpuk, Province of Kalinga From the Pinukpuk Vocational High School, Converting It Into An Independent National Vocational High School to Be Known as Tappo Vocational High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Pinukpuk Vocational High School - Tappo Annex in Barangay Apatan, Municipality of Pinukpuk, Province of Kalinga From the Pinukpuk Vocational High School, Converting It Into An Independent National Vocational High School to Be Known as Tappo Vocational High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Tappo của Trường Trung học Dạy nghề Pinukpuk tại Barangay Apatan, Đô thị Pinukpuk, Tỉnh Kalinga khỏi Trường Trung học Dạy nghề Pinukpuk và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Dạy nghề Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Dạy nghề Tappo, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Tappo ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาอาชีวศึกษา Pinukpuk ในบารังไกย์ Apatan เทศบาล Pinukpuk จังหวัด Kalinga ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาอาชีวศึกษา Pinukpuk และยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศอาชีวศึกษาแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาอาชีวศึกษา Tappo และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Tappo, Sekolah Menengah Kejuruan Pinukpuk di Barangay Apatan, Kotamadya Pinukpuk, Provinsi Kalinga dari Sekolah Menengah Kejuruan Pinukpuk dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Kejuruan Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Kejuruan Tappo, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Tappo, Sekolah Menengah Vokasional Pinukpuk di Barangay Apatan, Perbandaran Pinukpuk, Wilayah Kalinga daripada Sekolah Menengah Vokasional Pinukpuk dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Vokasional Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Vokasional Tappo, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National Vocational High School. – The Pinukpuk Vocational High School – Tappo Annex in Barangay Apatan, Municipality of Pinukpuk, Province of Kalinga is hereby separated from the Pinukpuk Vocational High School and converted into an independent national vocational high school to be known as Tappo Vocational High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. – All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Pinukpuk Vocational High School – Tappo Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Tappo Vocational High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Tappo Vocational High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriations of the Pinukpuk Vocational High School – Tappo Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
